text:
maria: Kingfisher POC failed during demo with 413 Request Entity Too Large. They inlined 3 images + full convo, payload ~5.7MB after base64.

devon: Are they hitting hosted sandbox or dedicated? paste the curl + Content-Length if you have it.

maria: Hosted sandbox. sanitized curl: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @payload.json` Payload size ~5.7MB. Gateway log: `upstream returned 413`.

devon: Quick triage: 1) stop inlining attachments -> presign + send s3 refs, 2) gzip the request (`Content-Encoding: gzip`), 3) send only last N turns or embeddings. Base64 adds ~33% overhead. Note some enterprise proxies strip gzip.

sylvie: If client can't change, we can flip a per-tenant flag to deref presigned objects on ingest for POCs. Needs ops signoff.

ops-bot: ops:ticket GW-1999 created, owner=sylvie, priority=high, ETA=90m for canary.

devon: Local test: gzip cut size ~65% and request accepted when `client_max_body_size` bumped. Hosted sandbox config locked -> hosted will still reject. Presign flow is the only non-infra path.

maria: Customer says plugin is legacy and can't change quickly. They're asking for server-side workaround for demo tomorrow. Can we do temp tenant increase?

sylvie: Ops can do a canary tenant increase for the sandbox (not prod). I'll run the canary and flip presign-deref flag if that is safer.

devon: Also tell them to trim to last 3 turns + minimal metadata for demo as fallback. We can provide a small helper script to extract attachments and upload to S3.

maria: I'll tell Kingfisher: presign refs preferred; if they want immediate short demo, we'll attempt the tenant toggle and ask them to test gzip+trim. Assigning: Sylvie -> run canary and/or flip flag; Devon -> send helper script; Maria -> notify customer.

sylvie: On it. ops:GW-1999 will include presign-deref flag flip and smoke test.

maria: Thanks team. Will update Kingfisher once canary is done. :thumbsup:
